scope: Published Graph Wasm with actual standalone owned kernel PCM hash comparisons shifted128; all5 effects at44.1/48/96 kHz, foreign gates13/41 and odd render blocks, f64 target automation, reset/save/reload and independent handles. Direct constructors reject actual Freeze before instantiating Wasm, ordinary routes still prepare, and actual dedicated-worker Freeze preserves matching-cadence PCM.
limitations: Declared128 frames measure adapter capture only; Rack Pitch native wet delay remains time-varying and is not fixed-delay compensated.
Freeze remains worker-only because its original synchronous capture can exceed an audio quantum deadline.
No physical listening or realtime deadline/speedup claim; private adapter allocation evidence is recorded separately.
